TOP row is MALE, BOTTOM row is FEMALE. Each row is ONE six-frame action, not six different characters. Do not copy the reference's 6x6 layout.

Entire head, hands, feet, garment and weapon tips must fit INSIDE each cell with at least 10% CLEAR transparent margin. Make poses compact enough to include the entire spear or bow. Never enlarge the character until cropped.
FRAME ORDER 0-5, LEFT TO RIGHT: ready/anticipation -> wind-up -> action release begins -> CONTACT/PEAK at hit or effect release -> follow-through -> recover to ready. Make six clearly different believable connected poses, with readable weight transfer and the most committed extension at the peak.

REFERENCE ROLE: the attached 6x6 atlas is identity, clothing and style reference ONLY. Its first two rows are male, next two rows female. IGNORE the final two modular-parts rows. Redraw connected FULL-BODY poses matching the exact face, costume, weapon, colours, line weight, warm painterly pixel shading and chibi proportions. Identity: cream shirt, navy trousers, red sash, brown ritual staff with bell and paper talismans; preserve male and female faces and ornaments.

TOP row is MALE, BOTTOM row is FEMALE. Each row is ONE six-frame action, not six different characters. Do not copy the reference's 6x6 layout.

Root/ground anchor at local x=160, y=276. Planted feet rest there; jumps and kneeling move naturally relative to that same ground anchor. Entire head, hands, feet, garment and weapon tips must fit INSIDE each cell with at least 10% CLEAR transparent margin. Make poses compact enough to include the entire spear or bow. Never enlarge the character until cropped.
FRAME ORDER 0-5, LEFT TO RIGHT: ready/anticipation -> wind-up -> action release begins -> CONTACT/PEAK at hit or effect release -> follow-through -> recover to ready. Make six clearly different believable connected poses, with readable weight transfer and the most committed extension at the peak.
